result: **No — do not restart the engine.** The harness skill for failed cycles (`.unown/skills/recover-failed-cycle/`) states explicitly that restarts break the auto-recovery state, and your project memory agrees ("Failed cycles auto-recover — do NOT restart engine to fix them"). Instead: wait 30–60 seconds, then check `GET /api/overview` — `ok:true` means the cycles already recovered on their own. If it's still failing after ~2 minutes, read the recent agent-service logs (`grep -i 'timeout\|retry\|watchdog'` over the agent-service log files) and note the failure pattern for memory. Only after **three or more repeated recovery failures** should you escalate to a manual review (still not a blind restart). A restart in the meantime risks clobbering the in-flight recovery state and is the one action that makes things worse.
